embershard_cleared.label: Clear the bandits at Embershard Mine

facts.text: The bandits at Embershard Mine are dead
A stranger in steel armor killed them
The stranger carried off the bandits' loot
The bandit leader fell to a war axe

riverwood_wolf.label: Kill a wolf at the Riverwood gate

facts.text: A wolf attacked at the Riverwood gate and was killed
The stranger killed it with a single arrow
